args.subject: Refund Confirmation for Invoice Correction (Ticket C-8044)
args.body:
Dear Fabrikam Ltd,

We have processed a refund of **310 CHF** to correct the invoice issued in the wrong currency (USD instead of CHF, as per your contract). This refund covers the conversion loss.

**Refund Details:**
- Amount: 310 CHF
- Reference: Ticket C-8044

Please allow 3–5 business days for the refund to reflect in your account. If you have any questions, reply to this email or reference the ticket.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
